answer: Every claim climbs the pulse of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the horizon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, held in escrow until finality, idle agents bleed standing. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the voyage of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
